description: Two-channel event processor with ten modes: an envelope, an LFO, a tap-tempo LFO, two drum pairs, a mini sequencer, two trigger utilities, a number station and a bouncing ball

params.text: Sets one parameter of the mode in use; which parameter that is changes with the mode and with the twin, split or expert setting, and the small display for the knob names it
Switches between twin, each knob setting one parameter of both channels, and split, the red knobs setting two parameters of channel 1 and the blue the same two of channel 2; ignored in expert mode
Turns expert mode on and off: with it on the two channels take separate modes and all four knobs edit whichever channel is selected; with it off both channels run one mode
Chooses which of the two channels the four knobs edit; pressing it changes nothing unless expert mode is on
Fires a trigger into channel 1, doing what a cable at TRIG 1 does
Fires a trigger into channel 2, doing what a cable at TRIG 2 does
Picks the mode from the ten the module carries; with expert mode on it sets the mode of the selected channel alone, and the matrix display for that channel names the choice

inputs.text: A voltage of 0.7V or more triggers channel 1; with the sequencer mode in twin or expert it advances the four-step sequence
A voltage of 0.7V or more triggers channel 2; with the sequencer mode in twin or expert it resets the four-step sequence instead of advancing it

outputs.text: Channel 1's signal, -8V to 8V, which is an envelope, an LFO, a drum, a sequencer step or a tone according to the mode
Channel 2's signal, -8V to 8V, which is an envelope, an LFO, a drum, a sequencer step or a spoken number according to the mode

notes: the module is monophonic: every jack reads or writes a single channel.
the two matrix displays name the mode each channel is running, and the four small displays name what each knob does in the mode and channel setting in use.
the module carries no control voltage inputs of its own. A Nix expander placed immediately to its right gives every parameter knob a jack and an attenuverter.
turning expert mode on copies channel 2's mode onto channel 1, so both channels start from the same mode before you set them apart.
menu: Knob pickup (snap) — makes a knob take hold of a newly selected channel's parameter only once it has been turned past the value that parameter already had
Add Nix expander — places a Nix expander immediately to the right of the module

inputs.0: high above 0.7V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0.7V · stepped · one channel only
